Replication census, the same table under the agreement and lenient rules. Extracted from the 986,179-domain call file (534 MB, not shipped) by scripts/census/extract_credits.py.

The 96 four-strand topologies with descriptors, rule flags and ECOD occupancy, used to fit the geometry score. Built by scripts/topology/build_frames.py from the Minami et al. Source Data (derived values only).
Connection-class support table (ECOD H-groups per connection and pair class) used by protein_shape.grammar.

Main census (AFDB v4 representatives cut at TED boundaries): one row per enumerated 5- to 7-strand topology with its rule flags, crossover-pair counts and superfamily occupancy under the agreement rule (L_H and alternative definitions). Built by scripts/census/build_occupancy.py.

Replication census (AFESM domains with ESMFold structures): the same table for the 2,961 frustration-free topologies with at least two parallel crossovers. Built by scripts/census/replication_occupancy.py.

external.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (AFDB)
external.version: v4, Foldseek cluster representatives as the Foldcomp afdb_rep_v4 database (2.3 million chains)
external.use: Structures of the main census. Not redistributed.

external.name: The Encyclopedia of Domains (TED)
external.use: Domain boundaries and superfamily labels of the main census. TED labels are TED assignments, not standard CATH assignments. Derived counts only.

external.name: AFESM
external.use: Clusters, domain boundaries and labels of the replication census. Derived counts only.

external.name: ESM Metagenomic Atlas (ESMFold models)
external.licence: not stated on the Foldcomp listing; check the ESM Atlas terms before redistributing structures
external.use: Structures of the replication census. Not redistributed.

external.name: ECOD
external.version: develop210 F99 domain list (geometry, H-groups); develop280 for H-group names
external.use: Solved-structure occupancy and family units. Derived quantities only; no file redistributed.

external.name: CATH
external.use: Superfamily and topology names for lineage analyses. Not redistributed.

external.name: Protein Data Bank
external.use: Crystal structures for crossover geometry, handedness and recovery checks, and figure renders.

external.name: Minami et al. (2023) Source Data
external.version: Source Data for Fig. 3 (fig3.xlsx), Nat. Struct. Mol. Biol. 30, 1132-1140
external.licence: not stated for the Source Data file (article CC BY 4.0)
external.use: Topology enumerations, the three rule flags and ECOD observation frequencies. Cited, not redistributed; frame4.csv holds derived values.

external.name: Murata et al. (2024) repository
external.url: see the paper for the repository

external.name: Koga laboratory design repository
external.use: NF design labels and structures for the folding test. Not redistributed.
